answer: Anchor every agent identity to a basalt-hard proof of sustained useful work: before an identity can transact, it must complete verifiable tasks whose cost is real compute and time. A nebula of fresh fake accounts cannot shortcut this history, because each one starts with zero track record and must pay the same price. When an identity turns malicious, its reputation collapses to its nadir and its escrowed bond is slashed, so creating many Sybils costs more than any single fraud can earn.
